missing_value_representation: Blank nullable cells only; zero remains observed; nonfinite numeric values are rejected.
clock_contract: Capture/publication values must already use a documented common clock; publication before capture is rejected.
source_contract: One source_kind per input file. synthetic_demo requires --demo; measurement cannot use --demo.
other_columns: Ignored by this reader; preserve original inputs and their provenance separately.
source_kind_authentication: Provider declaration only, not cryptographic proof of physical acquisition.
regional_contract: A predeclared region, independent reference qualification and source association must support these optional observations. True qualification plus observed zero region points is a violation; missing or false qualification leaves regional support unknown.
